nodes.name: Part 1: Data Population - Fetch All Posts

parameters.jsCode: const MIN_WORDS = 120; const MAX_EMBEDDING_INPUT = 1024; const cleanHTML = html => (html || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const posts = $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(p => p.content && p.content.rendered); if (!posts.length) { return []; } return posts.map(post => { const plainText = cleanHTML(post.content.rendered); return { json: { id: post.id, title: post.title, link: post.link, date: post.date, plainTextContent: plainText.slice(0, MAX_EMBEDDING_INPUT) } }; }).filter(p => p.json.plainTextContent.split(' ').length >= MIN_WORDS);
